page.layout: One page of text, with a dedication heading at the top, then running text in one column. No running head, no page number. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.head: Illustribus & generosissimis: Dominis Dn. FRIDERICO: Dn. FABIANO: Burggraviis & Baronibus à D o n a, Consiliariis Electoralibus Brandeburgicis, in Ducatu Borussiaco, præcipuis.
main_text.p: REs sacra & planè divina Naturæ studium est, Illustres & generosissimi Domini: In hanc ibit senten-tiam, quisquis Physicum, quem Naturæ Venatorem & speculatorem Cicero interpretatur, cum vili, ad pastum abiecta & naturalium rerum inani anima contende-rit. Quam enim corporis ergastulo cir-cumscriptam & inclusam à Natura men-tem mortales circumferimus, non vt tanti depo-

page.notes: The initial R is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "es" as "REs". The dedication heading is set in mixed roman and italic, with "Dona" in spaced capitals. The text ends mid-word at "depo-" and continues on the next page; no catchword is printed. The greeting lines are centred and set in italic.
